description: Stores a picture for a handbook article, as the article editor's Upload Image does, and returns its url and path. Put the url in the article's markdown as ![alt](url) through edit_handbook_article. Send the picture bytes as content_base64 with its file_name; a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, 5 MB at most. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the image the first call stored.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: upload_sop_image
title: Upload a picture for a handbook article
